questions.loading: JFE input C, 1 GOhm gate bias; source follower reduces Cgs loading
questions.dc_bias: gate at rail/4; 3.3 kohm source degeneration; fixed parts across device spread
questions.gain_or_impedance_transformation: source follower then AC coupling into real CMOS differential driver
questions.balanced_output: NPN follower plus emitter-degenerated NPN inverse/follower; finite unequal impedances measured
questions.expected_noise: JFE voltage/current/flicker plus gate/polarization resistors and both output opamps
questions.expected_distortion: source-follower curvature, drain modulation and output clipping
questions.quickest_falsification: Full stationary-noise contribution comparison with parent; preserved DC and transfer, then all supported tests
questions.hypothesis: If the unfiltered final 1Mohm backplate feed dominates the conventional reference noise, an actual 100nF backplate bypass should lower that contribution without selecting a JFET or changing voltage conversion.

topology.internal_device_classes: JFET input; NPN audio drivers and power
topology.hypothesis: If the unfiltered final 1Mohm backplate feed dominates the conventional reference noise, an actual 100nF backplate bypass should lower that contribution without selecting a JFET or changing voltage conversion.
topology.structural_changes: Retain JFE source degeneration, all bias/output devices and nominal values. Add one ordinary 100nF 100V PET capacitor after the final backplate resistor, testing its observed dominant Johnson-noise path. No trimming or device selection; rerun full suite.
